name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 22, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Paul Buchman, Member of the Community
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamations to outgoing Miss Teen Tri-City and Miss Pride of Vista Lions Club and introduction of the new courts. (CC)
P2.
North County Lifeline presentation to the winners of the Fair Housing Poster Contest. (CC)
P3.
Presentation by Karen Fleming of the Women's Resource Center of Oceanside announcing the launching of their Spanish Speaking Website. (CC)
P4.
Presentation to Kathy Valdez, Community Outreach Program Manager, in recognition of her receiving the 2008 Public Health Champion Award from the County of San Diego's Health and Human Services Agency. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Support of Proposition 99 on the June 2008 Ballot (CC)
C5.
First Amendment to the Sound Equipment Rental Agreement (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Renaming of Townsite Park to Luz Duran Park (CC)
D2.
RBF/Urban Design Studio Services Agreement (CDC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Vacation of a Portion of Watson Way (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , vacating a portion of Watson Way, a public street;
2.
Authorize the City Engineer to take actions to close the identified portion of Watson Way; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the document with the San Diego County Recorder.
PH2.
Appeal of Planning Commission Approval of PC2-100 (Highland Drive Subdivision), Matthew Altman, Applicant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Mitigated Negative Declaration for a ten lot single-family residential subdivision and one lot for a private residential street at 1035/1045 Highland Drive; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Tentative Subdivision Map and Density Bonus for a ten lot single-family residential subdivision and one lot for a private residential street at 1035/1045 Highland Drive.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
